title: State of the Feed — Week of August 24–30, 2026
content_html:
This week processed 16,500 articles across 10 aggregation runs, delivering 830 quality-filtered articles for curation. The news category dominated volume at 250 articles, followed by ai-tech (149) and wellness (100). Local content remained a consistent 50 articles despite lower weighting in the composite scoring model. Pipeline efficiency held at a mean noise-to-signal ratio of 1.77, indicating stable filtering performance within the historical range of 0.56–3.67.

Seven new feeds were integrated into the aggregator, with Ness Labs, Dropbox Tech, and Tech in Asia scoring highest among discovery candidates (94.7, 89.4, and 78.3 respectively). Additional subscriptions included MIT News programs, Singularity Hub, Neuroscience News, and several specialty blogs. Five existing feeds reported delivery errors this week: OpenMedia, Harvard Health Blog, Old House Journal, Cottage Life, and Consumer Reports. These require investigation for connectivity or structural changes.
